claims.text: The diagonal now covers 6 mutations and all three verdicts of the admission control, with ZERO off-diagonal movements: D1 gate 0->1, D2 anchors 0->1, D3 trajectory 0->1, D4 admission 2->1 BREACH, D5 admission 2->0 GATE CONFIRMED, D6 admission 2->3 PRESENT_BUT_UNEXERCISED. Each mutation moved exactly its own test and left every other test at its clean verdict.

D5 is the branch that mattered and had never been exercised: given a mirror implementing a CORRECT allow-list — exploit refused, canon admitted — the admission control returns exit 0 GATE CONFIRMED. Its exit-1 BREACH branch had fired before, but only against gates I had deliberately broken. A verifier that can condemn a bad implementation but cannot recognise a good one would have been useless the day ARM-08's gate lands, and that property was untested until now.

The diagonal found a real DEFECT-3-class collision in my OWN control. D6 originally reported 'NOTHING CHANGED' — but the verdict text had changed correctly to PRODUCT_AUTHORITY_PATH_PRESENT_BUT_UNEXERCISED. Both that state and PRODUCT_AUTHORITY_PATH_ABSENT exited 2, so 'no gate exists anywhere' and 'a gate exists that I could not reach' were indistinguishable to any exit-code reader — including my own run_tests.py. That is precisely the exit-code collision I found and fixed in the E11 gate as DEFECT-3, reproduced in the instrument I built afterwards.

Fixed by giving PRESENT_BUT_UNEXERCISED its own exit code 3, with run_tests.py taught that 3 means UNEXERCISED and reported on its own line, distinct from INCONCLUSIVE. Verified both ways: D6 now moves 2->3 and is diagonal, and the LIVE suite is unchanged at admission=2 ABSENT, suite exit 2, because in my worktree no gate genuinely exists. The fix distinguishes the two states without altering the honest verdict where only one of them applies.

tests.command: python3 diagonal.py  # 6 aimed mutations x full suite, scratch trees only

risks: Exit 3 is a NEW code in this fleet's test vocabulary. Any external runner that treats non-zero as failure will read UNEXERCISED as a defect. That is safer than the collision it replaces — it over-reports rather than hiding a real path — but it is a contract change and anyone consuming these exit codes needs to know.
Six mutations, all chosen and aimed by me. Diagonality is evidence of independence over the cases I thought of, not a proof over the cases I did not.

D6's fixture is a hand-written header carrying the structural tokens, not ARM-08's real file. It proves the control reacts to the token surface; CHECKPOINT-33 is where it was run against the genuine C++ tree.
